title: Cinchona officinalis essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Cinchona officinalis essential oil is derived from the bark of the cinchona tree, which is native to South America. It is known for its high concentration of quinine, a compound historically used to treat malaria. In herbalism, this essential oil is valued for its antimalarial, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. It is often used in aromatherapy to support respiratory health and to alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. Additionally, it may be applied topically to reduce fever and ease muscle pain.
